name: TopOpt
description: Topology optimization: pick a design body, supports and loads; get a lightweight, stiff part as a mesh or solid.

body.title: Design body
body.description: The solid that bounds the part (a blank or the part's envelope). Material is only placed inside it.

keep_out.title: Keep empty
keep_out.description: Optional: bodies whose space must stay free, such as bolt heads, cables or neighbouring parts.

material.title: Material
material.description: Sets the stiffness (for deflection and stress) and the density (for the mass).

oneOf.title: Custom (set E, nu, density in the panel)

volume_percent.title: Keep
volume_percent.description: Share of the design body's volume the part may use. Less is lighter but bends more and is more stressed; 25-35 % is a good start.

element_size.title: Element size
element_size.description: Edge of one cubic element. Smaller gives finer struts and takes longer. 0 = from the element budget.

max_elements.title: Element budget
max_elements.description: Elements in the body's bounding box. 40 000 for a first look (minutes); 100 000 or more for the final part.

min_member.title: Thinnest member
min_member.description: Smallest strut or wall. Larger gives fewer, thicker struts that print more easily. 0 = about three elements.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Faces of the design body that are bolted, clamped or resting on something. They stay in the part, joined to it.

fix_x.title: Hold in X
fix_x.description: Untick to let the faces slide along X.

fix_y.title: Hold in Y
fix_y.description: Untick to let the faces slide along Y.

fix_z.title: Hold in Z
fix_z.description: Untick to let the faces slide along Z.

replace.title: Item to change
replace.description: Filled in when you double-click a row; 0 adds a new support.

delete.title: Delete this item
delete.description: With an item number: remove it instead of changing it.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Faces of the design body the force acts on. The total force is spread evenly over them.

oneOf.title: Along X, Y, Z (enter Fx, Fy, Fz)

case.title: Load case
case.description: Loads with the same number act at the same time. Different numbers are separate situations the part must survive (a landing, a side hit).

replace.title: Item to change
replace.description: Filled in when you double-click a row; 0 adds a new load.

delete.title: Delete this item
delete.description: With an item number: remove it instead of changing it.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Faces of the design body that must stay exactly as they are: mating, sealing or cosmetic faces.

thickness.title: Solid depth
thickness.description: Solid material kept under the faces. 0 = the pad thickness (about 1.5 elements).

replace.title: Item to change
replace.description: Filled in when you double-click a row; 0 adds a new kept surface.

delete.title: Delete this item
delete.description: With an item number: remove it instead of changing it.

id.title: Item
id.description: The number in the # column of the panel.

widget.text: 1. Design body: where material may go. 2. Supports: faces held. 3. Loads: faces pushed. Optional: Keep surface for faces that must not change. Then Optimize on the Run tab.
Double-click a row to change or delete it.

Optimize runs in the background (operations panel, bottom right); press Refresh to see its progress. Create body inserts the result; Re-mesh remakes it with the Mesh settings without optimizing again. With TopOpt Solver running, it uses every CPU core or the GPU.
Start with Keep 30 % and a budget of 40 000; raise the budget for the final part. Compare the stress on the Run tab with your material's strength.

fields.label: Keep, % of the body (less = lighter, weaker)
Join every support to the part (may run twice)
Time limit, s (the run stops, keeps its result)

widget.text: Pick a preset. Changing E, the Poisson ratio or the density makes it Custom. E sets the deflection and stress, the density the mass.
How the result is turned into a surface. Change these, then press Re-mesh on the Run tab: no new optimization. If Create body gives only a mesh, try the HC smoother.

fields.label: Smoother: HC (keeps volume, solids most often)
Keep the body's faces exact (mounting faces)
Keep the body's sharp edges sharp
Round the joints to supports and loads
Create body makes a solid (off = mesh body)

widget.text: The defaults suit most studies. A thinner pad leaves more material to the optimizer and often gives a stiffer part.

fields.label: Use TopOpt Solver when it is running (faster)
Solid pad under supports, loads, kept faces (0 = auto)
Move limit per iteration (0.2; lower = steadier)
Trim thin dead weight: max stiffness loss, % (0 = off)
